title: Broken Elastic
text: Broken Elastic. I would have given this five stars if it had been sewn correctly. The first time I went to use one of the towels, the elastic popped off. I had to sew it back on. I also wish the "tail" that you twirl your hair in was a little deeper. I have long, thick hair and it is always spilling out of the tail of this towel. However, it absorbs water like crazy! And it doesn't frizz my hair. So, those are good things.

product_metadata.title: Flexible Plastic Cutting Boards for Kitchen Set of 3, WK Foldable Cutting Board Mats with Juice Grooves, Non Slip Cutting Boards for Meat, Dishwasher Safe, BPA Free, Black
features: Fold Design - Our black chopping board has a 1.5cm foldable edge. 100% Collect juices and crumbs from food to prevent them from falling onto the countertop. The foldable cutting board set make it easy to keep kitchen tidy. Our unique flodable cutting board is patent pending.

High Quality - Our flexible cutting boards are 1.3mm thick, much more durable than other thin cutting boards. Our cutting mats are build to last, they are BPA free, dishwasher safe and knife friendly.

Gripped Back - For better anti-slip, we upgraded the texture of the bottom of the chopping board. Stronger grip of the dot texture instead of waffle texture, so that the board will not slide on the countertop when cutting food.

Easy to use - These thin cutting board sheets are flexible enough to bend and transport food. These 3 black cutting boards for meat, chicken, fruit, vegetables or bread. In addition, they can be used as placemats and trays for lightweight items, meet all your kitchen needs.
Excellent customer service - Don't worry about our product, if you have any issues, we will help solve it within 24 hours.
